reviewed_pages.scope: Read whole original. All five aligned words including second baseline kʰa-le-m are present and match. Literal and idiomatic translations are separately preserved; no additional lexical forms in introduction.

All five proverbs and aligned words reviewed. Six English gloss tokens misclassified as targets are now controls and six corresponding blank glosses restored. Tilde over final u confirmed in ṭʰaũ. Preserve kjahau versus kiti-hau, source bird-GEN versus people, and EMP label.

Both riddles, solution prose and pihini reviewed. Dense and jungle have separate original alignment and remain separate; cəmpa rani shares Champaqueen and is grouped. All four private locative markers are tilde over schwa. Preserve source speak-3SG-NPST and be-NPST-3SG order.

All four expressions and riddle solution reviewed. Four English gloss candidates are controls; corresponding source words restored to their glosses. Seven records with private nasal glyphs corrected only after original verification. Ritual pinḍo explicitly means rice ball for offering; passive-like prose analysis retained separately from literal 1PL verb glosses.

All five expressions and 29 aligned words reviewed. Four private markers confirmed as final nasal i. Literal creemate-ABS, moisten-PRF versus pound-PFV, bən-a-ikun versus banaikun, and surface ukʰrake versus u-ke retained. Procedural functional-passive claim is source-attributed and does not replace literal first-person plural labels.
Entire original contains English discourse genre table and theoretical discussion only; no additional Darai lexical evidence.
Entire original contains English TAM category counts and chart, without printed Darai marker forms. Footnote identifies How to make wine and Jackal and Hen as the counted texts; retained as context.
Entire original contains English narrative TAM discussion and frequency chart; no additional target forms.
Entire original contains English comparative TAM chart and discourse theory; no new target lexical evidence.

Both openings, seven aligned words and explicit past copula reviewed. Source locality and speaker verified: Som Lal Darai, Kathar VDC, eastern Chitwan, limited to Jackal and Hen. des-jə̃ source gloss country lacks LOC and remains literal. No coordinates inferred from narrative country/village.

All three utterances and 15 aligned words match original. First country gloss omits LOC while second includes it; literal distinction retained. Speaker identifiers HP.BLD and KaQ.SLD remain distinct from JaH.SLD; source story settings are not elicitation locations.

All three expressions reviewed; restore do-SIM and morning to separate words. JaH.BLD.014 is explicitly printed, unlike nearby SLD identifiers, and is not normalized. Surface kodʰorojəjə̃ has repeated material absent interlinear kodʰor-jə̃; both literal tiers retained. ciŋniĩ lacks segmented hyphen in this source instance.

All five expressions and 40 aligned words reviewed. Separate where/wait-PST glosses. Source evening/daybreak and yes/no discrepancies typed. Plain dʰuk in 11e contrasts with retroflex ḍʰuk in 11d and is retained. terake versus toi-ke source-tier difference retained; all corpus IDs match.

Two expressions and all aligned words reviewed; while and jackal restored to separate words. Source wait gloss versus hiding contextual translation retained. Remaining English prose has no omitted Darai forms.

All five dialogue expressions and 23 aligned words reviewed. Original ama-ĩ explicitly glosses next-ERG despite Mother in translation; typed uncertainty. arko-hĩ and arko-ĩ differ across adjacent examples, while both surface forms have h; literal source tiers preserved. Narrative animal roles do not change ordinary word glosses.

Both expressions, 14 aligned words, and explicit sequential -ikun reviewed. Source muḍʰe-k versus muḍ-k distinct literal occurrences retained, as are ONO and fear-INST analyses. Prose does not supply independent onomatopoeia lexical meaning beyond whole translation.

All four surface blocks, 32 aligned words and temporal əse prose reviewed. Evening/again separated; two glosses contaminated by intervening English full translation restored. Final surface spans two clauses with SQ.BLD.132 and .133, retained together with separate translation groups and all nine words. Retroflex koḍʰor versus plain earlier kodʰor retained.

Original English-only conversation is preserved as context, including derogatory father explanation; no target words supplied there. Final Darai question and all five aligned words agree; source SLD.014 differs from BLD.014 witness on p338 and remains literal.

All four utterances and 22 aligned words agree. Explicit discourse-particle and emphatic-clitic headings retained for metadata. Retroflex wait forms and AUX.PST on rəhə-m differ from earlier plain-d/COP witnesses and remain literal; pʰəlna source gloss this preserved.

Five utterances and all 18 aligned words reviewed without additional literal corrections. Preserve source emphasis, marked postverbal noun phrases and final postposed purpose clause as contextual analysis, not reordered utterances.
Original chapter summary is English only; no additional quoted Darai forms. Full 21-page original review completed.
